```yaml
name: Abuse Detection Cron

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: abuse-detection
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  abuse-detection:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run abuse detection
        env:
          DATABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DATABASE_URL }}
        run: npx tsx scripts/detect-abuse.ts --last 24h --parallel 3 --auto-apply
        timeout-minutes: 60
```
